summary.text: Charles Tuttle is an independent candidate for North Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat in 2026.
He has run for statewide and federal office several times since 2018, most recently in the June 2026 special primary for state Superintendent of Public Instruction.

paragraphs.text: Tuttle first ran as an independent for North Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat in 2018, receiving 4.1% of the vote in a race won by Kelly Armstrong.
In 2020 he ran for Superintendent of Public Instruction, finishing third in the nonpartisan primary with 19.7%, and then ran as a write-in candidate in the general election.
In 2022 he ran as an independent for Secretary of State, receiving 9.2% of the vote in a race won by Michael Howe.
He lost the June 9, 2026 special nonpartisan primary for Superintendent of Public Instruction, receiving 14.4%.
